title: Smart Data Models - AGROVOC - Label
description: A reified lexical label (skosxl:Label). AGROVOC publishes every preferred, alternative and hidden label as its own resource with an AgrovocCode notation, a term type and term-to-term relations (acronyms, synonyms, scientific names, old names, symbols). Attributes are the properties actually used on AGROVOC labels in release 2026-11-05 (counted on the AGROVOC SPARQL endpoint), named exactly as in SKOS, SKOS-XL, DCMI and the Agrontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<AGROVOC local id> (e.g. c_8373, xl_en_1299522993458, agrovoc).

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Label'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp (NGSI-LD system attribute; the source's own dct:created is 'created').

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification (NGSI-LD system attribute; the source's own dct:modified is 'modified').

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

sameAs.description: Relationship. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs'. Not an AGROVOC statement (Smart Data Models addition): the canonical AGROVOC IRI of this resource (http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrovoc/<local id>), which the NGSI-LD entity id is derived from.

literalForm.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2008/05/skos-xl#literalForm'. The lexical form of a reified label (a language-tagged string). Used 1,266,017 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Language map: one string per BCP 47 language tag (can be exchanged as an NGSI-LD LanguageProperty).

notation.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#notation'. A string of characters used to uniquely identify a concept or label within the scope of the vocabulary (in AGROVOC, the AgrovocCode). Used 1,266,001 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05).

created.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.org/dc/terms/created'. Date of creation of the resource (xsd:dateTime as published; some values have no timezone). Used 1,265,923 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05).

hasTermType.description: Property. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasTermType'. Agrontology 'Has term type'. Used 270,261 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05).

modified.description: Property. Model:'http://purl.org/dc/terms/modified'. Date on which the resource was last changed (xsd:dateTime as published; some values have no timezone). Used 174,633 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05).

isAcronymOf.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#isAcronymOf'. Agrontology 'Is acronym of'. Y <is acronym of> X. An acronym is an abbreviation formed from the initial letters of other words, often pronounced as a word. “AIDS” <is acronym of>”acquired immunodeficiency syndrome”. Used 120,976 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

hasSynonym.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasSynonym'. Agrontology 'Has synonym'. X <has synonym> Y. Y <has synonym> X. “Bulgaria”<has synonym>”Republic of Bulgaria”. Used to distinguish an exact and current synonym from obsolete terms which might have been used in the past (for that, use <has old name>). Use only between labels for the same concept in a specific language. Used 119,582 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

hasRelatedTerm.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasRelatedTerm'.  Used 47,783 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

hasScientificName.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasScientificName'. Agrontology 'Has scientific name'. X <has scientific name> Y. E.g. “sea trout” <has scientific name> "Salmo trutta”. Label-to-label relationship for use within a concept. Use when common name and scientific name are not separate concepts, or when a separate relation between scientific and common name is needed for a specific language. When common name and scientific name are separate concepts, use concept-to-concept relation <has taxonomic concept/has common name concept>. Used 16,980 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

scientificNameOf.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#scientificNameOf'. Agrontology 'Scientific name of'. Y <scientific name of> X. E.g. “Salmo trutta” <scientific name of> "sea trout”. Label-to-label relationship for use within a concept. Use when common name and scientific name are not separate concepts, or when a separate relation between scientific and common name is needed for a specific language. When common name and scientific name are separate concepts, use concept-to-concept relation <has taxonomic concept/has common name concept>. Used 16,980 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

isReplacedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'http://purl.org/dc/terms/isReplacedBy'. A related resource that supplants, displaces or supersedes the described resource. Used 5,514 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Concept or Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Concept:... or urn:ngsi-ld:Label:...).

hasAcronym.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasAcronym'. Agrontology 'Has acronym'. X <has acronym> Y. An acronym is an abbreviation formed from the initial letters of other words, often pronounced as a word. E.g. “acquired immunodeficiency syndrome” <has acronym>”AIDS”. Used 1,622 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

changeNote.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#changeNote'. A note about a modification to a concept or label. Used 1,250 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Language map: a list of strings per BCP 47 language tag.

hasOldName.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasOldName'. Agrontology 'Has old name'. X <has old name> Y. Use for obsolete labels, such as old names of countries. E.g. “Bulgaria”<has old name>”People’s Republic of Bulgaria”. Use only between labels for the same concept in a specific language. Used 988 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

isOldNameOf.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#isOldNameOf'. Agrontology 'Is old name of'. Y <is old name of> X. Use for obsolete labels , like old names of countries. E.g. “People’s Republic of Bulgaria” <is old name of> ”Bulgaria”. Use only for labels for the same concept in a specific language. Used 988 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

hasSymbol.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#hasSymbol'. Agrontology 'Has symbol'. X <has symbol> Y. “iron” has symbol ”Fe (symbol)”. Use for disambiguation of chemical element symbols from other similar abbreviations. Used 707 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

isSymbolFor.description: Relationship. Model:'http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrontology#isSymbolFor'. Agrontology 'Is symbol for'. Y <is symbol for> X. ”Fe (symbol)” <is symbol for> “iron”. Use for disambiguation of chemical element symbols from other similar abbreviations. Used 707 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Targets are AGROVOC Label entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Label:<label id>).

deprecated.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#deprecated'. True if the resource is deprecated. Used 363 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05).

editorialNote.description: Property. Model:'http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#editorialNote'. A note for an editor, translator or maintainer of the vocabulary. Used 3 times on 1,266,017 AGROVOC labels (release 2026-11-05). Language map: a list of strings per BCP 47 language tag.
